title: Sprite
description: Glyph-grid art plus a parallel ink grid naming colour roles (ASSETS.md sec 3). What the schema cannot express - art/ink dimensions matching the declared cell, every ink key existing in inkMap - is enforced by the content linter.

frameMs.description: Idle-cycle cadence in wall-clock milliseconds (WBS 4.1). Ambient animation is presentation time, never sim time: the view cycles frames on its own clock, a reduced-motion player sees frame 0 forever, and the sim knows none of this. Format-agnostic on purpose - frames are plain grids, nothing importer-specific (decided 2026-08-17).

frames.description: Additional idle frames beyond the base art (which is frame 0). The cycle is [base, ...frames], each the same cell size as the base - enforced by the content linter.

inkMap.description: Ink key to palette role. 'PATH' resolves to the instance's upgrade-path colour; null is transparent.
